description_en: HuggingFace model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. Pipeline: image-text-to-text. Downloads: 5,595,700.

title: Wizstar R1
description_en: Seedance 2.0-level product videos at a lower cost. Wizstar R1 is an in-house AI video model built for affordable, everyday creation. Combine up to nine reference images and videos to generate 5–15-second videos with native audio, guided by your products, characters, scenes, and styles. R1 excels at animation and 3D content and matches Seedance 2.0's usable-output rate for product videos in internal tests. Eligible members enjoy unlimited, credit-free generation, giving creators more freedom to experiment and refine their ideas.

title: overads.io
description_en: Marketing and GTM that run while you sleep. overads runs marketing and GTM for founders, end to end. Describe a job once and it becomes a workflow that runs every week. It writes, designs and schedules posts for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and Pinterest. It watches your Meta and Google ads, and you can pause a campaign or move a budget right from chat. GTMgenie runs your outbound on email and LinkedIn. Nothing goes out without your yes. One plan, $59/month.

title: Depost AI
description_en: The LinkedIn AI agent that learns what works for your brand. Depost AI scores every LinkedIn post you've published against your own average, finds what's winning in your niche, then plans the month, writes in your voice, and designs the graphics. You approve every post, and it publishes through LinkedIn's official API. It also drafts replies to the conversations worth joining, so posts turn into leads—works in the app, or inside Claude and ChatGPT over MCP.

title: Contral
description_en: The AI coding agent that checks its work and teaches you. Contral is out of beta. Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI or Copilot CLI inside Contral, on your own account. Contral checks every turn against what you asked for and sends smaller models a specific correction, explains every change with a teaching card, and undoes a whole turn in one click. Plus Defense Mode, video explanations by Scrimba, and Learn mode in 5 languages. In VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf and more, or the Contral IDE. Free to start.

title: Periscope
description_en: Turn any work into an API. Describe a task and get an endpoint for it. An agent does the work through the screen on its own cloud desktop, in any software, however old. Call it over REST, or from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor over MCP. The Free plan needs no card.

title: GrayPass
description_en: Verify who’s in control before agents make sensitive actions. Login tools tell you who signed in. GrayPass verifies who’s still in control when it actually matters. Before a wire, payout change, admin grant, or other sensitive action executes, GrayPass uses behavioral and session evidence to decide whether to allow, re-verify, hold, or deny it. Its Brainprint learns how each person types, moves, and scrolls without capturing what they type, adding fresh assurance without forcing MFA on every user.

title: Dex Telemetry
description_en: Open-source Datadog for analytics. You set up analytics to monitor your business. But who's monitoring your analytics? Dex Telemetry gives you observability for your pipelines, with rules and context built for your agents.

title: Pushary Calls
description_en: Miss your AI agent’s ping? Pushary calls you.. Your AI agent stops to ask before it does anything big. If you're at lunch, it sits there until you're back. Pushary sends the question to your phone. Miss it, and Pushary calls you. You hear what the agent wants and say yes, no, or what to do instead. Then it keeps working. Calls only ring in hours you pick. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Hermes and more.

title: Superrelay
description_en: One inbox for every app you ship, never priced per ticket. One support workspace for teams shipping several apps: chat, email, WhatsApp, Slack and in-app in one inbox. An AI agent that cites sources and asks before acting, GitHub-synced docs, and a CLI/MCP so coding agents read tickets. Never priced per ticket.

title: Espresso 27
description_en: The web editor for people who love the Mac. The biggest Espresso ever. A new look for macOS 27, an AI that builds across your whole site without a line of it leaving your Mac, and an editor with far more under the hood.

title: snibl
description_en: Save highlighted text from any app, then ask AI about it. Stop losing the things you read. Highlight text in any app on Mac or Windows and Snibl saves it with its source and context, so you can find it later. Then just ask: Snibl AI answers your questions using your own saved snippets. Software you actually own

title: slay
description_en: AI composition guide camera app for iPhone. slay is an iPhone camera app that overlays 14 composition guides directly on your live camera view — Portrait 1, Portrait 2, Close Up, Side Chick, Travel Shot, One-Third, Two-Third, Vanishing Point, One-Point Vertex, Two-Point Vertex, Triangle 1, Triangle 2, Aerial Triangle, One-Point Aerial — each with the camera height, angle, zoom and distance to use, plus 38 built-in LUTs, so photos are framed and post-ready without editing.

title: Woomool
description_en: AI Canvas where thinking becomes tangible. Woomool is a AI canvas tastefully designed for ideation, knowledge management, and live collaboration. Clean, unobtrusive, and beautiful, it inspires you to focus and go deep into your thinking.

title: ChickyTutor
description_en: A language tutor that knows you better daily. Now on iOS. Hi Product Hunt! I’m Phanos, founder of ChickyTutor. We’re returning with our new iOS app for iPhone and iPad. Talk face to face with your AI language tutor, answer out loud, get gentle feedback when something needs fixing, and try again straight away. You can pick your language and level, follow guided Journey chapters in supported languages, and keep your practice synced across iPhone, iPad, Android, and the web. Try it at https://www.chickytutor.com/mobileapp

title: Prosed AI 2.0 + MCP
description_en: Your company's words, assembled into a book. Prosed AI is now for businesses. Your team has already published the ideas. Prosed AI assembles them into a non-fiction book inside your assistant. The Source Map and review packet help reviewers focus on the joins. Bring a body of work, not just an idea. AI-assisted bridges are marked for review. One book: $299, once. Free until the outline. $149 until Mon Nov 30

title: Prosed AI 2.0 + MCP
description_en: Your company's words, assembled into a book. Prosed AI is now for businesses. Your team has already published the ideas. title: Onset
description_en: AI reviews, titles and thumbnails for YouTube creators. Onset reads your own YouTube Analytics and reviews each upload 48 hours after it goes live, then drafts titles in your voice and thumbnails in your channel's style. Read-only: it never posts. We're letting creators in from the waitlist, a few at a time.

title: gpyou
description_en: The OpenRouter for compute for the cheapest GPU in stock. One CLI for GPU clouds worldwide. gpyou rents the cheapest GPU in stock, moves to the next offer when one is sold out, and bills per second from prepaid credit. Run containers, fine-tune, serve models or a coding model of your own.

title: airoom
description_en: An open-source control room for your Claude Code agents. Every project is a room and every Claude Code session is a desk. See who is working, who is waiting on you and who is stuck. Chat, approve commands, hire a team, or let an agent test your app in the built-in browser. Free, local and open source.

title: Ploid
description_en: People search for AI agents, across 2B+ profiles. Ploid is a people search engine with a living index of over two billion people. Search by role, company, skills or location, get up to 150 results per request, and merge someone's professional, social and personal sites into one Superprofile. Agents can reason over posts, photos and talks, not just database fields. Available as API, CLI and MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Cursor.

title: Arbitrica
description_en: Agent that finds hidden prices & fights pricing algorithms. Arbitrica is an AI agent that detects the world’s lowest price for anything online, starting from hotels globally. The price we're shown is the result of which country we search from; what phone we use; what time we look at... Behind this are pricing algos designed to maximise revenue from every person. Arbitrica gives people an agent that fights back. It wakes up when you are about to pay, searches from 195 countries, finds the lowest price on Earth, and prepares everything checkout ready

title: Bento
description_en: Runnable lessons and interactive maps of GitHub repos. Bento is a free, open-source Mac app for learning how software works. Get runnable lessons from questions or take apart GitHub repos. It uses the AI subscription you already have. Try ready-made lessons and featured repos in your browser, no install.

title: Spark AI
description_en: AI-native permitting & diligence services for data centers. Will that data center actually come online? Spark offers AI-native services built on a permitting intelligence platform: agents research 20,000+ jurisdictions, and an expert reviews every deliverable. Used by NextEra, Prologis, Intersect (Google), and others with a combined 200 GW pipeline. Three services: Stakeholder Intelligence (who decides, how they voted), Permit Matrices (which permits, from whom, timelines), and Project Diligence (risks from regulation, utilities & power, competition).

title: DearDarling
description_en: A couples messenger with a mutual friend, Pip. One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. A private messenger for two, with Pip: a mutual friend who knows your chat, gives one tip when you ask, and talks to each of you alone without taking sides. Every night, your day becomes a page.

title: OpenCrawl
description_en: Multiplayer for your coding agents. OpenCrawl lets your coding agents search each other's histories and talk to each other, across laptops and cloud coding environments. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more. Open source, self-hostable and free to start.

title: Tallhorn
description_en: A native MongoDB® client where AI agents ask before writing. Tallhorn is a fast, native MongoDB® client for Mac, built with SwiftUI and AppKit. Browse documents as a table, tree or JSON, script queries in JavaScript, build pipelines stage by stage, read explain plans, and turn queries into dashboards. A built-in MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code query your databases under rules you set per connection, and by default every agent write waits for your approval. No account, no analytics. Free; Pro adds dashboards and agents, $29.99 once.

title: gutcheck
description_en: Check your gut against the internet, inside Claude Code. Before you build it, find out if anyone wants it. Type /gutcheck and an idea, a problem or a decision in Claude Code. It plans a study, pulls live evidence from Google Trends, Google News, Hacker News, GitHub, the App Store, Wikipedia and the web, and gives you a verdict: how sure it is, the case against, and what to do this week. No API keys to start. Runs on your machine. Free and open source.

title: Stacktrace
description_en: Real-time steering and guardrails for AI agents. Stacktrace is a control layer for AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Devin. It reads their tool calls, blocks unsafe ones before they run, enforces the limits your team sets and steps in when an agent drifts from its intent.

title: Wender Desktop
description_en: A 100% free Paper alternative. Wender Desktop is a 100% free HTML canvas design tool for Mac. Use your own agent subscriptions, own your files forever and self host on a free Cloudflare plan for sharing and collaboration, and work with your real code and components. No MCP limits. No seat limits.

title: ro
description_en: I won't bother you. ro sits quietly on your Mac desktop or menu bar and stays out of your way. Free as a desktop pet that reacts to your apps. Unlock Pro for local file search (⌥R), Downloads cleanup with undo, and private AI handoff. Nothing leaves your Mac.

title: Botric
description_en: Invisible in AI Search? Get your brand into AI answers. Track and improve your brand's visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and more. Monitor mentions, citations, and competitors, and create optimized content with Botric's content agents to increase your chances of being recommended by AI.

title: Botric
description_en: Invisible in AI Search? Get your brand into AI answers. Track and improve your brand's visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and more. Monitor mentions, citations, and competitors, and create optimized content with Botric's content agents to increase your chances of being recommended by AI.

title: Tote
description_en: Help your AI find real Black Friday deals in your size. A free add-on for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Gemini. Tell your AI your sizes and taste once, find real Black Friday deals with 90 days of price history, and get Deal Watch emails when prices drop. Tote never buys for you: you always check out yourself.

title: Wisp
description_en: Your AI, right where you're looking. Wisp is a screen-aware AI companion that lives beside your cursor — on Mac, Windows, and the web. Press a key and just talk: it sees what's on your screen, answers out loud, and flies a cursor to point at exactly what it means. It goes past answers too — teaching on a live whiteboard, tutoring you topic by topic, building posters, slides and docs in Studio, and running real multi-step tasks in your apps and browser. Free to start, nothing to set up.

title: Purgy
description_en: Deep-clean your Mac: hidden files, System Data and AI models. Purgy finds what macOS hides: System Data, app leftovers, hidden folders, and unused AI models, and frees the safe part in one click. It also checks the important security settings of your Mac. Try it free for 3 days, then pay $20 once and use it for life.

title: AI Builder Week by Product School
description_en: Free 20-minute AI workshops to build better products, faster. AI Builder Week is a free, five-day online event from Product School, the learning platform for AI Builders. 10+ live workshops, 20 minutes each, Dec 7-11. You're in the tool, building an agent, a workflow or a feature you've been putting off. Pick the sessions you want, attend live, and get the recording. You leave each session with something you made and the exact setup to build the next one yourself. Leaders from Amazon, Google, Atlassian, Vercel, SpaceXSI, Gamma and more are on the lineup.

title: Gold Master Kit
description_en: Claude Code skills that launch your Mac or iOS app. Five Claude Code skills that make your app's App Store screenshots, link previews, launch posts, launch film and landing page from its real UI. Every skill checks its own files before it says done. Tested blind against plain Claude Code.

title: OfficeBats
description_en: The online AI office suite, eleven apps for one price. OfficeBats is an all-in-one AI-powered workspace to create documents, spreadsheets and presentations, edit PDFs, design websites and graphics, collect e-signatures, manage finances, build forms and handle customer support, all with integrated cloud storage and AI assistance.

title: TigerTrust
description_en: Enterprise PKI Management & Certificate Lifecycle Automation. TigerTrust – Simplify PKI and Certificate Lifecycle Management. Enterprise certificate lifecycle management with discovery, automated renewal, HSM-backed private CA, SCEP/ACME/EST issuance, TPM attestation, and compliance evidence packs.

title: Cinemation - AI Long Videos Maker
description_en: Create long videos, cinema, serials, promotions & more.. Cinemation is an AI movie maker that turns an idea or script into long videos (up to 30 min) with the same characters and locations in every scene. Pick a genre, length and cast; it writes the script, plans wide/medium/close-up shots, generates the visuals and stitches them into one film. Edit any shot in plain English. Live action, 3D, anime, claymation or cartoon; 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1; 5 languages. For creators, marketers and educators.

title: Reeltopus
description_en: Topus, the 8-armed video agent: research, make, post, grow. Tell Topus what you want, or let Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor drive him over MCP. He finds what your niche searches for and which videos are breaking out, makes clips, reels and carousels from anything, edits by chat with undo on every step, tests titles and thumbnails, and posts to 9 platforms once you approve. A 4-hour video is ready in as little as 3.6 min.

title: PropIQ 2.0
description_en: AI deal analysis for lean real estate acquisition teams. PropIQ scores a rental deal and shows cash flow, cap rate and ROI from a few inputs, with an AI analysis of the risks. Built for small residential acquisition teams. Join the waitlist for early access.

title: Sepiasend
description_en: Resend's API on Cloudflare: same code, lower bill. Keep Resend's SDK and send through your own Cloudflare account. Change two environment variables; Cloudflare delivers at its own price, domains are unlimited and free. Includes an MCP server so Claude and coding agents can set it all up. By Squidcode.

title: Viraloop
description_en: Don't just get views. Get paying customers.. Views don't pay the bills. Add your website and Viraloop creates, schedules and auto-posts a month of short-form content built to sell your product on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook. Swipe through AI UGC videos, slideshows, memes and ads in Turbo Mode, remix trending formats for your niche, pick from 500+ AI avatars, and let the calendar post daily. A REST API, MCP server and CLI let your agents run the whole loop.

description_en: One workspace. Your entire AI agent team.. Stop juggling separate AI chats. Build a team of specialized agents with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and 20+ supported agents. Seira is open source (Apache 2.0), with a free desktop app for Windows and Linux and self-hosting options. Start with one bot, then build your team.
